_readme: The What's New book (WhatsNew.java). One entry per player-facing change, newest first within each date. Add new entries at the top with every jar. pass: the Blender pass label as written on the review site, or empty. steps: how to get there, one short line each. triggers: ids passed to WhatsNew.done (server) or sent by the client (lab.<row key>.<value> when a Ring Lab row is set); a trailing * matches any id starting with the rest. No triggers = ticked with Mark done only.

entries.title: Arm stays on when charging at a set-down lantern
steps: Lantern in the off hand, K > Lantern > Charge style: a set-down one (L1c push, K3c kneel, lean, shrine)
Charge in first person: your arm leans toward the lantern and its light streams to your ring
You stay where you started until the charge ends; let go of the clicks to stop

entries.title: Lasso wrecks through blocks
steps: G > Lasso, hold right-click on a mob
Swing the bubble through a wall: the blocks break and fly off the way you swung
Let go: the sphere comes apart, and a hard throw still flies on
Throw a mob into a hillside: it gouges a crater along the way it was going

entries.title: Red battery: Dark Lantern size, deep crimson
steps: Red ring, Red battery in your off hand
Charge at it (Shoulder lean too): no bigger than the Dark Lantern
Under shaders the stone stays deep crimson with a glossy highlight

entries.title: Dome stays above the ground
steps: Ring in Dome mode, stand by a pit or slope
Hold right-click
The dome stops at your feet and never runs down into the ground

entries.title: No click boom in flight
steps: V, fly with the ring
Clicking no longer launches you to 60 b/s with a sonic boom
Shift while flying forward is still hyper speed, with its boom

entries.title: Drills lose their bottom plate
steps: G > Blast, hold right-click
No flat plate at the drill's back; same glow
Every drill model: K > Combat > Drill model

entries.title: Steer the Blast drill
steps: G > Blast, hold right-click: the drill forms and waits
Left-click: it bores straight on
Double-click: it curves toward where you look
Double-click and hold: it keeps turning and boring

entries.title: Ultimate dome is solid to you too
steps: Green lantern out, look up, hold R
Once the dome has formed, walk or fly into it
You bounce off it like everything else

entries.title: Fear Nuke: drop in, throw, heavy fall
steps: Yellow ring in Aerial mode
Hold right-click: the nuke drops into place over your ring in half a second
Aim and let go: it's thrown that way in a heavy arc, no hovering
It goes off on contact, or with its bottom about 5 blocks over the ground

entries.title: Calmer lantern charge
steps: Charge the ring at the lantern in first person
No light shafts across your view
The world dims, but no longer goes black

entries.title: Red battery shines like diamond
steps: Red ring and Red battery in your off hand
Patched Complementary pack on
The crimson stone now gleams like a diamond block

entries.title: This book
steps: Ticks itself when you try each entry
Mark done for the ones it can't see
New copy: K > Updates > Get the What's New book

entries.title: Softer glow under shaders, L3 core swirl
steps: With your shader pack on, build constructs and punch
Glow no longer washes the screen green
Charge at the lantern: only the core swirls

entries.title: Punches in first person
steps: Ring in hand or worn, on foot
Left-click: the ring fist jabs, the free fist guards
P1c hook: K > Combat > Punch

entries.title: Flying flurry in first person
steps: V, fly with a charged ring
Left-click a mob: jab, cross, backfist
Arm size: K > Combat > First-person punch and flurry arms

entries.title: Pass names in the Ring Lab
steps: K > any tab
Takes read like the review site: Pass 836 · H3 Braid

entries.title: Ultimate dome
steps: Green lantern: crouch + R to summon it
Look up (45° or more)
Hold R: a 150-block dome

entries.title: Omega beams chain from mob to mob
steps: Charged ring on you
Aim at a group of mobs, hold X
K > Beams > Omega beams: chain

entries.title: Punch, blast and wall poses
steps: Ring in hand or worn, on foot
Left-click: P1b jab (P1c hook in K > Combat > Punch)
Blast and Wall show their poses too

entries.pass: Pass 505 · R3a-3 Dash strike, flying ring fist
entries.title: Dash strike
steps: Charged ring, on foot
Left-click a mob 4.5 to 6.5 blocks away

entries.title: Army construct pig
steps: G > Army
Hold right-click, left-click until Pig
Let go: it rams hostiles
P3 weave: K > Looks > Construct pig

entries.title: Light rays from constructs
steps: Build a Wall, Dome or Bridge
Look for shafts and dust in the light
K > Looks > Construct light rays

entries.title: Lances and flowing ring beams
steps: K > Beams > Beam look: L1, L2 (pass 834) or T2-T6 (pass 830)
G > Beam, then right-click

entries.title: Eight test lasers
steps: K > Beams > Beam look
Pick H3, N1, N2, N3, P1, C1, C2 or C3
G > Beam, then right-click

entries.title: Lasso bubble controls
steps: G > Lasso
Hold right-click on a mob to catch it
Scroll to reel out or in
Swing and let go to throw

entries.title: Lantern charge light
steps: Lantern of your ring's colour: crouch + R
Hold right-click with the ring to charge
Watch the core swirl in the glass

entries.title: Constructs shatter when hit
steps: Ring in hand or worn
Left-click a Wall, Dome or Bridge block

entries.title: Outline flash on hurt mobs
steps: Hurt a mob with a punch or any ring power

entries.title: Double-tap landing, 0.3 carry
steps: Fly within 5 blocks of the ground
Double-tap jump
Also works flying forward: brake, drop in

entries.title: Ring arm leads the flight
steps: Fly and turn: the ring arm leads
D3 adds a bank: K > Flight > Ring arm leads

entries.pass: Pass 403 · R3A2 Dart, arm a little forward
entries.title: Running dart take-off
steps: V, then run
Jump, then jump again in the air
A1 arm at the side: K > Move > Take-off: free arm

entries.title: Ring slot
steps: E: put the ring in the slot above the off hand
It stays on your right hand
An empty hand works as the ring

entries.title: Tools mode
steps: Green or Blue ring > G > Tools
Right-click: six tools in the hotbar
Mine or fight with them; right-click again to put away

entries.title: Shift hyper speed
steps: V, then sprint-fly forward
Hold shift: sonic boom

entries.title: Primed flight slam
steps: In hyper speed (shift)
Look 40° down and dive into the ground
Left-click the crater within 3 s to rebuild

entries.title: Primed super-jump slam
steps: Flight off: sprint about 0.75 s, jump
Crouch on the way down (or hold left-click)

entries.title: Lined slide trench
steps: Flight off: sprint, super jump
Land fast without priming: the slide leaves a lined trench

entries.pass: Pass 519 · K3c Kneel, pick the lantern up
entries.title: Set the lantern down
steps: Lantern in the off hand
Crouch + hold right-click on a block
Stands one block tall; in-hand size: K > Lantern > Set-down lantern size

entries.title: Hip carry and first-person kneel
steps: K > Lantern > Charge style: Hip carry or K3c kneel
Charge the ring and watch in first person

entries.title: Ring Lab keeps your picks
steps: K: change any row; new jars never undo it
★ new on a row = a newer pick to try
✎ adds a note; Updates tab saves a profile

entries.title: Construct hammer swing
steps: G > Hammer
Tap right-click: overhead swing
Tap at a wall: R2b side swing

entries.title: Omega beams
steps: Charged ring on you
Aim and hold X
Several mobs: barrage; works under water

entries.title: Rings R19d, R12b, R12c, R16a
steps: K > Ring > Ring model
Step to R19d, R12b, R12c or R16a

entries.title: Square emblem rings
steps: K > Ring > Ring model
N04 is the ★ pick; also P03 and N01

entries.title: Double-jump take-off
steps: V (flight on), stand still
Jump, then jump again in the air

entries.title: Super jump into ground flight
steps: V on, sprint until the jump arms
Jump, then double-tap jump while sprinting

entries.pass: Pass 510 · S3 H5 S3 M3 slam, 5 blocks
entries.title: Big flight slam
steps: V, sprint-fly fast
Dive 40° down into the ground
Height: K > Combat > Flight slam

entries.title: Flying flurry
steps: V, fly with a charged ring
Left-click a mob

entries.pass: Pass 519 · R4b Absorb and fire back
entries.title: Absorb and return blast
steps: Ring in hand or worn
Hold left-click while a skeleton shoots you
Let go to fire it back

entries.pass: Pass 519 · D0 Power landing, stop dead
entries.title: Power landing
steps: Flight off: sprint, super jump, don't prime
Slow: stop dead; fast: A3 dissolve
B2 plough: K > Move > Power landing slide

entries.title: Ring Lab tabs and search
steps: K: tabs along the top, type to search
Tab and arrow keys move; Copy report

entries.pass: Pass 601 · C6a L1c charge, C6a timing
entries.title: Charge: lean in or kneel
steps: K > Lantern > Charge style: L1c lean or K3c kneel
Lantern out (crouch + R), hold right-click with the ring

entries.title: Ground flight and sonic boom
steps: V, sprint, look 25° down
Double-tap jump: skim the ground
Go fast for the sonic boom; trail: K > Flight > Flight trail

entries.title: Saw mode
steps: Green ring > G > Saw
Hold right-click on a block, drag along the ground
Hold left-click too to cut a trench

entries.title: Nebula lantern light
steps: K > Lantern > Lantern model: Nebula
Nebula light: L1 Column or L4 Core & cage

entries.title: Black hole: spreading eat, final bang
steps: Green ring > G > Black Hole
Hold right-click to aim, left-click for size
Let go and wait for the bang

entries.title: Blast drills
steps: G > Blast, hold right-click (left-click: level)
Let go: the drill bores in
Drill model: K > Combat; barrier T1-T9: K > Looks

entries.title: Hope sanctuary
steps: Place a Blue lantern near animals or villagers
Crouch + right-click it with a ring
The squad domes them, a sanctuary forms above

entries.title: Super jump and sprint
steps: Flight off, charged ring: sprint about 0.75 s
Jump: low forward arc, WASD steers
Prime in the air: crater + dome landing

entries.title: Hammer leap and smash
steps: G > Hammer
Hold right-click to aim the landing ring
Let go to leap and smash

entries.title: Ram barrier
steps: V, sprint-fly fast for about 2 s
Fly into a wall or another barrier

entries.title: Bridge
steps: Green or Blue ring > G > Bridge
Hold right-click to pick a level
Hold left-click too to build; space up, crouch down

entries.title: Wall: pin and drag
steps: G > Wall
Hold right-click to pin it, drag 3x3 to 17x17
Let go

entries.title: Green Deluge
steps: G > Deluge
Hold right-click, let go: glowing hard-light flood

entries.title: Red battery and bloodfire
steps: Get a Red lantern and ring
K > Corps > Red constructs and Red lantern

entries.title: Blue rescue squad
steps: Place a Blue lantern
Crouch + right-click it with any ring

entries.title: Red rage
steps: Get hurt by a Red Lantern: a red-ring mob,
a Rage Bull or a player with a Red ring

entries.title: Orange horde
steps: Orange lantern: crouch + R
Hold R

entries.title: Red self-destruct
steps: Red lantern: crouch + R, hold R
You die and lanterns within 15 blocks break

entries.title: Fear Nuke
steps: Yellow ring > G > Aerial Drop
Hold right-click until it's built in the sky
Let go (costs 75-90%)

entries.title: Dread Runner
steps: Yellow ring > G > Blast
Hold right-click, left-click to level 4
Let go
